title: CBIC Eases ATA Carnet Rules: More Time for Temporary Imports!
content:
# CBIC Eases ATA Carnet Rules: More Time for Temporary Imports!

Ek important update hai! Government ne ATA Carnet rules mein amendments announce kiye hain, jisse temporary imports ke liye ab additional time mil paayega. This is a welcome move for businesses and individuals relying on the ATA Carnet system.

Previously, goods imported temporarily under an ATA Carnet generally had a four-month period for re-export. However, with the latest amendment, the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) has introduced more flexibility.

*   **What's New:** The Principal Chief Commissioner or Chief Commissioner of Customs now has the authority to extend the existing four-month period for re-export of goods imported under an ATA Carnet.
*   **Conditions Apply:** This extension will be granted if the Commissioner is satisfied that it's necessary in the public interest. However, the extended period cannot go beyond the overall validity of the ATA Carnet itself.
*   **Official Reference:** This change has been brought into effect through **Notification No. 36/2026-Customs dated 13 November 2026**. This notification specifically amends Notification No. 4/2018-Customs dated 18 January 2018.

This move provides much-needed relief and operational ease for entities like businesses, exhibitors, and professionals who temporarily bring goods into India but may require more time for their re-export due to various circumstances.
